_comment: Regression baseline for the real-tower fixture at --seed 7, checked by
gates: the sensor model is still invented (ADR 0014), so the absolute
numbers mean little. What they catch is movement -- a change that makes
the solver or verifier worse than it is today.
false_complete_rate is the one that matters most and is currently
perfect. Nothing else in CI protects it.
convergence_rate is 0.0 because the reconstructed edge model injects a
systematic per-view bias the solver cannot overcome. It is baselined at
its true value rather than aspirationally, so the entry starts guarding
Tolerances absorb small floating-point differences in the Metal raster
pass across runner GPUs. They are not headroom for regressions.
Regenerate with --update and explain the movement in the commit message.
